policy.primary_rule: Do not publish a new URL merely to increase page count. Every indexed page must answer a distinct question, provide unique value, and disclose its evidence and review status.
preferred_actions: redirect a retired URL to the strongest surviving answer
retain a supporting brief only when it serves a distinct reader need
prohibited_shortcuts: mass-generated articles without independent research value
treating forthcoming manuscripts as evidence for public claims
policy.deletion_rule: No indexed URL is removed solely because it is short. Removal or consolidation requires overlap analysis, link preservation, and an explicit redirect plan.
policy.measurement_freeze: During the initial 30-day baseline, titles, canonical URLs, and pillar scopes remain stable unless a factual or safety correction is required.

classes.pillar: Reference-grade dossier with a narrow question, substantial original synthesis, transparent evidence architecture, and bilingual or planned international reach.
classes.pillar_candidate: Strategically valuable topic that requires a complete rebuild or second-language edition before promotion as a reference asset.
classes.supporting_brief: A bounded explainer serving a distinct question and linking into a pillar; it must not compete with the pillar for the same search intent.
classes.literary_guide: A craft or interpretation page whose value is literary rather than medical or scientific.
classes.hold_for_review: Retained while overlap, traffic, external links, and consolidation risk are measured.
